sources.title: The Fairness-Accuracy Pareto Front
sources.snippet: Algorithmic fairness seeks to identify and correct sources of bias in machine learning algorithms. Confoundingly, ensuring fairness often comes at the cost of accuracy. We provide formal tools in this work for reconciling this fundamental tension in algorithm fairness. Specifically, we put to use the concept of Pareto optimality from multi-objective optimization and seek the fairness-accuracy Pareto front of a neural network classifier.
